title.zh: 【摩根大通资管公司将代币化货币市场基金扩展至 Solana】
title.en: 【摩根大通资管公司将代币化货币市场基金扩展至 Solana】

current_state.zh: JPMorgan Asset Management opened its tokenized money market funds MONY (a 506(c) private fund) and JLTXX (a US-registered government money market fund aimed at GENIUS Act-compliant stablecoin issuers) to qualified US investors on Solana, with subscriptions and redemptions via the Morgan Money liquidity platform and token balances delivered to on-chain addresses.
current_state.en: JPMorgan Asset Management opened its tokenized money market funds MONY (a 506(c) private fund) and JLTXX (a US-registered government money market fund aimed at GENIUS Act-compliant stablecoin issuers) to qualified US investors on Solana, with subscriptions and redemptions via the Morgan Money liquidity platform and token balances delivered to on-chain addresses.
